title: Jungle Boss: exploring Phong Nha on a multilingual website
summary: A multilingual website for an adventure tour operator in Phong Nha, balancing the inspiration to explore with practical booking information.

blocks.text: International travelers looking for adventure tours need to feel inspired and also trust the operator enough to book: what the tour includes, how hard it is, the price and how to book.

items: Guests come from many countries and need multilingual content.
Adventure tours need clear safety information and difficulty levels.
Visual emotion must come with practical information so guests feel confident booking.

blocks.text: I led content structure and experience: how each tour is described, the order of information on the page, and the voice for international guests.

items: Open the page with imagery and story, with the tour information right below.
Duration, difficulty, price and inclusions, in the same structure.
The content structure is prepared to add more languages.

items: Travelers need inspiration and reassurance at the same time.
